card.name: Verbs before an ongoing state
card.fires_on: Short linking or auxiliary words like 'were', 'be', 'being', 'still' and 'back' after a subject such as 'they', 'you' or 'we', right before an -ing verb or a state description. Also 'time' in 'in no time'.

modes.label: Auxiliary after subject
modes.description: A form of 'be' after 'they', 'you' or 'we' that leads into a continuing action.
modes.example: Soon they<< were>> so plentiful, local botanists thought

modes.label: Still / back
modes.description: An adverb such as 'still' or 'back' that signals a continuing or returned state.
modes.example: astronomers are<< still>> hotly debating its origin and implications.

modes.label: In no time
modes.description: The word 'time' ending the phrase 'in no time'.
modes.example: measuring temperature with this amazing homemade tool in no<< time>>.

card.plain: It fires on small words like 'were' or 'still' that come just before a description of something ongoing.
